scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspace=pi-bot-desktop && npm run typecheck --workspace=@pi-bot/admin && npm run typecheck --workspace=@pi-bot/a2ui
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-timeout=120000 server/tests/*.test.ts packages/agent/tests/*.test.ts packages/a2ui/tests/*.test.ts packages/bot-face/tests/*.test.ts desktop/tests/*.test.ts extras/virtual-phone/tests/*.test.ts
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@pi-bot/admin && npm run build --workspace=@pi-bot/server
